## FAANG Engineering Checklist
<!-- Ensure you have completed all of the following before requesting a review. -->
- [ ] My code follows the strict style guidelines of this project (ESLint / Prettier).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand asynchronous areas or complex regex.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the `README.md` or `docs/` folder (if applicable).
- [ ] My changes generate NO new warnings or console errors.
- [ ] I have added/updated `Jest` integration tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`npm test`) without database pollution (using memory-server).
- [ ] Any dependent API changes have been updated in the Postman/Swagger/Documentation specs.
